properties.documentation:
Possible Errors:
Error: Username may still exist if they previously had an account (inactive users are purged every 6 months). User will see the error message "This username is in use"
Resolution: Mobile CARE purge the old user profile. Alternatively the user may use another username that is not their email address
Error: Failure in downstream system (e.g. TIL / CRM6). Error message asks user to try again later. 
Resolution: User tries again later. If the problem persists and they 
contact Mobile CARE, Mobile CARE will log an Incident into IT.
